## Argument (C66-GEO-Z)

### Setup and scope
Work exclusively over the balanced tetragonal stack B^{bal} of smooth genus-6 curves with a degree-4 map gamma: C → P^1 of fibrewise splitting type F ≅ O_{P^1}(4) ⊕ O_{P^1}(5). Let C → B^{bal} be the universal curve. This node constructs and identifies the CE evaluation-failure locus on that balanced open piece only. Downstream nodes C66-GEO-H0, C66-GEO-COMP, C66-TATE-*, and C66-CEX-* are not discharged here. Blocked routes (vcd-only-vanishing; undecorated-cgp-top-weight-graph-complex; point-count-without-degree-parity-separation; forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown) are not used and are not reopened.

### Step 1 — CE convention and degrees (source-backed + elementary RR)
Packet convention: W_5 is the f_2=5 summand of (O(2) ⊗ gamma^* F^vee)|_C, written
W_5 := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) ⊗ gamma^* O_{P^1}(-5))|_C,
and is not the O(5) summand of F. SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 gives deg(W_f|_C) = 4g + 12 − 4f. At g=6, f=5: deg W_5 = 16 and deg L = deg(W_5 ⊗ omega_C^{-1}) = 16 − (2g−2) = 6. The CE obstruction degrees for a relative divisor Gamma of degree n=6 are
deg(omega_C ⊗ W_f^vee(Gamma)) = 4f + n − 2g − 14,
hence f=4 ↦ −4 and f=5 ↦ 0 (FND-0062, FND-0063, FND-0074; SRC-0004). Claims: CLM-Z-SETUP, CLM-Z-DEG.

### Step 2 — Filtered CE reduction, no global split (proved)
On the balanced locus F is fibrewise O(4)⊕O(5), so the relative Harder–Narasimhan filtration supplies a canonical short exact sequence 0 → L_5 → F → L_4 → 0 over any base. Dualizing and applying the CE twist yields a canonical filtration
0 → W_4 → W → W_5 → 0
with W_4 of degree 20 and W_5 the degree-16 quotient (FND-0097). No global splitting W ≅ W_4 ⊕ W_5 over B^{bal} is assumed: the extension class lives in H^1(B, gamma'_* O(1)) and need not vanish on the universal balanced stack.

Because Gamma is finite over the base, both pi_* and restriction to Gamma are exact on this filtration. On geometric balanced fibres the f=4 obstruction has negative degree, so coker(phi_4)=0. Snake lemma therefore gives coker(phi) ≅ coker(phi_5) as modules, and
Fit_0(coker phi) = Fit_0(coker phi_5).
Define Z^{bal}_{ev} := V(Fit_0(coker phi)) = V(Fit_0(coker phi_5)) as a closed subscheme of Div^6_{C/B}. Claims: CLM-Z-FILT, CLM-Z-FILT-COKER.

### Step 3 — Geometric-point failure law (source-backed + Serre)
On any smooth geometric balanced fibre, for any effective Gamma of degree 6:
- H^0(C, omega_C ⊗ W_4^vee(Gamma)) = 0 because the bundle has degree −4 (FND-0062);
- omega_C ⊗ W_5^vee(Gamma) has degree 0, so H^0 ≠ 0 iff the bundle is trivial, iff O_C(Gamma) ≅ L = W_5 ⊗ omega_C^{-1} (FND-0063).
Thus geometric points of Z^{bal}_{ev} are exactly the Abel–Jacobi points O(Gamma) ≅ L. Residual writeup: that these H^0 groups are precisely the CE evaluation obstruction spaces of SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 (not merely degree-matched Serre-dual proxies) is recorded as GAP-Z-CE-OBSTR (FND-0061). Claim: CLM-Z-GEOM-PT.

### Step 4 — Scheme structure / Fitting vs AJ (source-backed outline + residual gap)
Fibrewise geometric-point equivalence does not by itself identify schemes over an arbitrary base (FND-0046). The scheme structure of Z^{bal}_{ev} is defined by Fit_0(coker phi_5). For the Abel–Jacobi incidence Z^{bal}_{AJ} ⊂ Div^6_{C/B}, the universal Pic^0 determinantal computation (FND-0096) states: with Gamma finite étale of degree n over the base and L_univ = omega(Gamma_P) ⊗ Poin^{-1} on C ×_S Pic^0(C/S), one has Fit_0(coker(p_* L_univ → p_*(L_univ|Gamma_P))) = I_e at the identity section. The (6,6) specificity enters only through deg N = 2g−2 − deg W_5 + n = 0, which is arranged precisely by the f=5 borderline degree (FND-0074, FND-0096). After translating the CE evaluation by L so that the obstruction is the degree-zero Poincaré-twisted model, this yields Fit_0 = I_e and therefore the intended equality Z^{bal}_{ev} = Z^{bal}_{AJ} as closed subschemes.

Residual high-severity gap GAP-Z-SCHEME-CMP: the full base-relative gluing of the CE W_5-evaluation Fitting ideal to the universal Pic^0 model over arbitrary bases of B^{bal} must still be written carefully (FND-0046). Do not replace this by an unqualified identification of the relative linear system with Proj(pi_* L) when h^0 jumps (FND-0047); the model used here is Fitting/AJ/divisor incidence, not unqualified Proj. Claims: CLM-Z-FIT-UNIV, CLM-Z-SCHEME (status gap).

### Step 5 — Ordered reduced-support model (proved)
Let Z^{bal,red} be the open locus of the failure model on which Gamma has reduced support. The forgetful map from the relative ordered configuration stack Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) of pairwise-distinct sections to the reduced-support open of the relative effective-divisor space is a finite étale S_6-torsor (FND-0064). Compatible reduction of source and target is required over possibly nonreduced bases (FND-0087). This open is an open piece of the failure locus, not a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6} (FND-0052). Stack-level: the torsor is on the stack of pairwise-distinct sections; coarse/integral descent needs separate justification downstream (FND-0075). Claim: CLM-Z-CONF.

### Step 6 — Mono into CE failure in M_{6,6}, not iso (proved as scope)
The balanced locus is open in the tetragonal locus. The natural map of the balanced failure model into the CE evaluation-failure locus in M_{6,6} is therefore a monomorphism onto the balanced open piece. Because unbalanced tetragonal failure is not constructed here, any claim that Z^{bal} is isomorphic to the full CE evaluation-failure locus in M_{6,6} would be self-refuting (FND-0091). Claim: CLM-Z-MONO.

### Step 7 — Nonemptiness, carefully (source-backed)
Riemann–Roch gives chi(L)=1 on every smooth geometric fibre, so the full Abel–Jacobi fibre inside Sym^6 is nonempty. Global nonemptiness of the proposed evaluation-failure locus is consistent with corroborated packet input FND-0005. Not claimed: that the reduced-support open, or the ordered Conf_6 incidence, is nonempty on every geometric fibre (FND-0083). Claim: CLM-Z-NONEMPTY. Residual low-severity marker: GAP-Z-RED-FIBRE.

### Step 8 — Explicit non-claims (handoff discipline)
The following are excluded from this theorem and deferred:
- constancy of h^0(L)=3 (equivalently h^0(M)=2 for M := omega_C^2 ⊗ W_5^vee of deg 4) and relative P^2-bundle structure / pure dim 17 / codim 4 (FND-0058, FND-0073) → C66-GEO-H0;
- components, stabilizers, global codimension, and exhaustive closure analysis (FND-0060, FND-0069, FND-0086) → C66-GEO-COMP;
- non-closedness of Z^{bal} in M_{6,6} without exhibiting a point of Z \ Z^{bal} (FND-0067) — not claimed;
- nowhere-lci conclusions without local depth/conormal (FND-0068) — not claimed;
- Tate type of cohomology of Z (FND-0053, FND-0054) → C66-TATE-SUPPORT;
- unbalanced tetragonal failure construction (FND-0091).
No undischarged identification W_5 ≅ omega_C^2(−D) is used (FND-0073). Claim: CLM-Z-SCOPE.

### Separation of inputs
- **Proved steps:** filtered reduction and Fit_0 equality of cokers (snake + Fitting); Conf_6 finite étale S_6-torsor over reduced-support open; mono-not-iso scope; explicit exclusions.
- **Source-backed inputs:** CE degrees and geometric-point failure law (SRC-0004 Lem. 10.6; FND-0062, FND-0063, FND-0074); universal Pic^0 Fit_0 = I_e (FND-0096); filtered form preferred over global split (FND-0097); stack/open discipline (FND-0052, FND-0064, FND-0075, FND-0087); nonemptiness of full AJ fibre / global Z (RR; FND-0005).
- **Computational hypotheses:** none.
- **Gaps:** GAP-Z-CE-OBSTR, GAP-Z-SCHEME-CMP, GAP-Z-RED-FIBRE.

### Failed approaches addressed
1. Global split of W over B^{bal} → replaced by HN filtration (FND-0097).
2. Balanced model isomorphic to all CE failure in M_{6,6} → mono of balanced open only (FND-0091).
3. Pure dim 17 / codim 4 without h^0 constancy and component analysis → not claimed (FND-0058, FND-0069).
4. Non-closedness of Z^{bal} without Z \ Z^{bal} → not claimed (FND-0067).
5. Conf_6 / reduced-support treated as closed pure-codim-4 in M_{6,6} → open of failure model (FND-0052).
6. Geometric points as scheme identity → Fitting/AJ comparison with residual gap (FND-0046).
7. chi(L)=1 ⇒ reduced-support nonempty every fibre → refused (FND-0083).
8. Degree/Serre alone as full CE identification → obstruction spaces tied to SRC-0004 Lem. 10.6 with GAP-Z-CE-OBSTR (FND-0061).
9. Unqualified Proj(pi_* L) when h^0 jumps → Fitting/AJ model (FND-0047).
Blocked cohomological routes are inapplicable to pure construction of Z and are not used.

### Handoff objects for downstream nodes
- Relative degree-6 incidence / failure model Z^{bal}_{ev} (Fitting) and L = W_5 ⊗ omega^{-1} for C66-GEO-H0 (stratify by h^0(L)=1+h^0(M), deg M=4).
- Ordered Conf_6 model and reduced-support open for C66-GEO-COMP and C66-COMP-RANK.
- Explicit mono-only embedding into M_{6,6} so Gysin support analysis can stratify balanced vs residual pieces later.

claims.statement: Over B^{bal} (smooth g=6 balanced tetragonal, F≅O(4)⊕O(5)), W_5 is the CE f_2=5 quotient (O_{P(E^vee)}(2)⊗gamma^*O(-5))|_C, not the O(5) summand of F; L:=W_5⊗omega^{-1} has fibrewise degree 6.
Relative HN of F yields a canonical filtration 0→W_4→W→W_5→0 over B^{bal}; no global split W≅W_4⊕W_5 is assumed.
deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f; at (g,n)=(6,6), deg W_5=16, deg L=6; f=4 obstruction degree -4, f=5 obstruction degree 0.
On geometric balanced fibres, CE evaluation fails on effective deg-6 Gamma iff O_C(Gamma)≅L=W_5⊗omega_C^{-1} (f=4 obstruction vanishes).
Gamma/B finite implies pi_* and restriction to Gamma exact on 0→W_4→W→W_5→0; coker phi_4=0 implies coker phi≅coker phi_5 and Fit_0(coker phi)=Fit_0(coker phi_5).
Universal Pic^0 determinantal lemma: Fit_0(coker of evaluation of L_univ on Gamma)=I_e at the identity when the translated obstruction has degree 0 (FND-0096).
Z^{bal}_{ev}:=V(Fit_0(coker phi_5)) equals the Abel–Jacobi incidence Z^{bal}_{AJ} as closed subschemes of Div^6_{C/B}, not merely on geometric points.
Forgetful Conf_6→(reduced-support open of the failure model) is a finite étale S_6-torsor; that open is open in the failure model, not a closed pure-codim piece of M_{6,6}.
The natural map of the balanced model into CE evaluation-failure in M_{6,6} is a monomorphism onto the balanced open piece; it is not an isomorphism onto all CE failure.

chi(L)=1 implies full AJ fibre in Sym^6 nonempty on every geometric fibre; global nonemptiness of Z is packet-corroborated (FND-0005); reduced-support/Conf incidence nonempty on every fibre is not claimed.

Excluded from this theorem: pure dim 17; global codim 4 in M_{6,6}; constant h^0(L)=3/relative P^2; components/stabilizers/closure; non-closedness of Z^{bal} without a point of Z\Z^{bal}; Tate of Z; full CE failure construction.

summary: Weakest-sufficient C66-GEO-Z lemma: construct the balanced CE evaluation-failure locus Z^{bal} via the filtered CE bundle 0→W_4→W→W_5→0 and Fitting of coker(phi_5); identify geometric points by O(Gamma)≅L=W_5⊗ω^{-1}; model ordered reduced divisors by a finite étale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open; mono-embed only the balanced open piece into CE failure in M_{6,6}. Residual gaps: full CE-obstruction match to SRC-0004 Lem. 10.6 and complete base-relative Fitting/AJ scheme comparison. No blocked routes used; no RED-0001 resolution claimed.
theorem_statement: Let B^{bal} be the moduli stack of smooth genus-6 balanced tetragonal curves (degree-4 covers gamma: C -> P^1 with fibrewise F ≅ O(4) ⊕ O(5)). Let 0 → L_5 → F → L_4 → 0 be the relative Harder–Narasimhan filtration of F, and let 0 → W_4 → W → W_5 → 0 be the induced canonical filtration of the Casnati–Ekedahl bundle, with W_5 := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) ⊗ gamma^* O_{P^1}(-5))|_C the degree-16 quotient (not the O(5) summand of F) and L := W_5 ⊗ omega_{C/B^{bal}}^{-1} of fibrewise degree 6. Let Div^6_{C/B} be the relative effective-divisor space of degree 6, phi (resp. phi_5) the relative CE evaluation map for W|_Gamma (resp. W_5|_Gamma), and Conf_6 the stack of ordered pairwise-distinct sections. Define Z^{bal}_{ev} := V(Fit_0(coker phi)) ⊂ Div^6_{C/B} and Z^{bal}_{AJ} the Abel–Jacobi incidence of O_C(Gamma) ≅ L. Then: (1) Fit_0(coker phi) = Fit_0(coker phi_5) with no global split of W used; (2) on geometric balanced fibres, CE evaluation fails on effective deg-6 Gamma iff O_C(Gamma) ≅ L; (3) scheme-theoretically, Z^{bal}_{ev} is cut out by Fit_0(coker phi_5), and equals Z^{bal}_{AJ} after the universal Pic^0 Fitting comparison at the degree-zero CE obstruction (residual base-relative writeup gap recorded); (4) Conf_6 → (reduced-support open of the failure model) is a finite étale S_6-torsor over that open, which is open in the failure model and is not a closed pure-codimension subvariety of M_{6,6}; (5) the natural map of the balanced model into CE evaluation-failure in M_{6,6} is a monomorphism onto the balanced open piece and is not claimed to be an isomorphism onto all CE failure. Explicitly excluded: pure dimension 17, global codimension 4, constant h^0(L)=3 / relative P^2 structure, components/stabilizers/closure analysis, non-closedness of Z^{bal} without a point of Z \ Z^{bal}, Tate type of any cohomology of Z, and construction of unbalanced tetragonal failure.
